status_effects.explanation: Forcheville is the incidental beneficiary of Mme Verdurin's arrangement, gaining proximity and favor at the moment Swann is excluded.

appraisal_events.evidence: « nous avons une petite place pour vous à côté de M. de Forcheville »
appraisal_events.explanation: In the same maneuver that shuts Swann out, Mme Verdurin arranges the carriage seating so that Odette rides beside Forcheville, favoring him with her company.
